weeks.rationale: First week on the re-anchored threshold (4:10/km @ 178 bpm) and the refreshed loads. A simulation week: threshold Tuesday, hinge-emphasis lower Wednesday, the first-half race simulation Friday and an easy long run Sunday. Volume is 56 km, a deliberate step up from the ~47 km actually executed over the last nine weeks, not a jump to the 62 km ceiling.
weeks.methodology: Polarized: threshold and the sim are the only hard running, everything else is easy, and strides add speed without fatigue. Threshold is prescribed at a fixed pace from the re-anchored LT2 and progressed by duration across the block. Heavy strength follows the running-economy template at loads taken from the athlete's own recorded sets, with plyometrics kept off hard-run days. Volume ramps gradually from executed, not planned, km.
